remarks: Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in Grumman Hill Village in sought-after So. Wilton with its highly-rated schools, this single-family PUD-style home offers the perfect blend of convenience and comfort. Located just off Route 7, you'll be close to shopping, dining, medical facilities and major commuting routes, making it an ideal choice. The 1st Floor features a large living/dining room, a bright and welcoming kitchen with breakfast bar, granite counters and an open floor plan with the family room complete with gas fireplace. The 2nd floor features the primary bedroom suite with full bathroom and walk-in closet, two additional generous bedrooms, providing plenty of space for rest and privacy and a dedicated home office offers the perfect space for remote work, study, play area or creative pursuits. Enjoy the convenience of a second-floor laundry and an attached 1-car garage. Excellent credit and references required. Two months' security deposit and $300 move-in/out fee. Don't miss the opportunity to be in before September.
